summary: Compute ~40 structural graph-theoretic predictors from the zebrafish connectome (shortest path, communicability, search information, mean first passage time, matching index, cosine similarity, adjacency, Euclidean distance and their in/out/all directed variants) via the Predictors class, correlate each one edgewise against the functional connectivity matrix, and rank them by how much FC variance they explain relative…
use_when: Analyze which structural graph predictor explains functional connectivity best?
Generate which structural graph predictor explains functional connectivity best? outputs
avoid_when: Connectivity estimates are unsupported because sampling, preprocessing, or matrix alignment is inadequate
